title: Stanislaw Lem quote related to LLMs
excerpt: A man can control only what he comprehends, and comprehend only what he is able to put into words. The inexpressible therefore is unknowable. -- Stanislaw Lem "The Futurology Congress"
content_html:
A man can control only what he comprehends, and comprehend only what he is able to put into words. The inexpressible therefore is unknowable. -- Stanislaw Lem "The Futurology Congress"

This is certainly interesting in LLM land :-)
